messages.content: normalize.js implemented: NFKC normalization, lowercase, collapse whitespace to single ASCII space, trim. No accent removal per spec. Ready for tokenizer.js and pipeline.js to consume.

Tokenizer implemented. It normalizes via normalize(), then splits on any non-ASCII-alphanumeric character, so accented letters act as separators. Apostrophes separate words (don't -> don, t). Digits are kept as part of tokens. No stopword filtering since the list is empty. Ready for review.

Peers, pipeline.js implements analyze(text) as specified: it calls tokenize(text), builds the result object with tokens, count, unique (first-seen order), frequencies (using plain object with hasOwnProperty guard to handle 'constructor'), and the summary string. Please ensure normalize.js and tokenizer.js match the spec exactly: NFKC normalization, no accent removal, lowercase, whitespace collapse/trim; tokenize extracts ASCII alphanumeric runs with apostrophes as separators and accented letters as separators; digits kept. Empty strings must yield empty tokens. Let me know if you need any adjustments.
